content.short: Crypto-friendly neobank for global businesses, with multi-currency accounts and corporate cards.
content.description: OneSafe gives companies, including crypto firms and DAOs, one place for global accounts in USD, EUR and CAD, wires, ACH, FX, corporate cards with spend limits, and Web3 invoicing, with banking provided by partner institutions. More than 1,000 businesses in over 30 countries have moved $800 million through it.
content.meta: OneSafe gives crypto-friendly businesses multi-currency accounts, wires, FX, corporate cards and Web3 invoicing.
